report_discrepancies.note: Transfers do not balance across funds: governmental funds transfers in 1,701,570 (p5) + Combined Utilities transfer in 213,806 (p7) = 1,915,376, versus transfers out 1,519,441 (p5) + 431,780 (p7) = 1,951,221. The Statement of Activities (p3) shows governmental transfers 217,974 against a governmental funds net of 182,129.

notes: GAAP city audit (CAFR). Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5); fund balance 16,564,532 -> 20,814,482. Other financing = sale of capital assets 50,815 + insurance recoveries 19,567. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet Cash and Cash Equivalents 4,244,215 (p4); ending_investments = Investments 14,019,428 (also CDs 211,383 and restricted investments 123,295 there), as in FY2024. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement Combined Utilities column (p7); the Internal Service fund (governmental activities, charges 1,421,842, reimbursements 294,326, expenses 1,667,147, interest 41,523, net position 729,539 -> 820,083) is not in the governmental funds and is not recorded. Business-type disbursements total = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 26,380,477 (p2). Capital contributions 6,183,726 in business_type.other_financing. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), primary government only. Detail: General Fund budgetary comparison (p10, budgetary basis, with budget); nonmajor special revenue (pp20-25), Debt Service (p26) and Capital Project Funds (pp27-28) budget schedules (budgetary basis, with budget; pp21, 23, 25, 28 are right-hand continuation pages read with the row labels of the facing pages 20, 22, 24, 27; p28 = Miscellaneous Projects column added in the re-trim, so Misc Projects now comes from its budget schedule instead of the combining statement); the combining nonmajor statement (pp11-16) is used only for the fund without a budget schedule (South Sioux City Community Foundation); utilities from the Combined Utilities departmental schedule (pp17-19), with nonoperating items only at fund level. Nonmajor 'Taxes' rows are property tax: the governmental funds statement prints 'Property Taxes' 2,964,618 for Other Governmental Funds, equal to the combining statement's nonmajor Taxes total; budget-schedule 'Taxes'/'Other Taxes' typed from that evidence or the fund name. Pages 29-34 are statistical-section tables (program revenues, fund balances, FTEs, operating indicators, capital asset statistics), not financial statements; not recorded. Read pages 1-34 of 34
